problems.problem: The agent failed to explicitly list the documents using the required labels "Retrieved required evidence documents" and "Missing required evidence documents".

The agent hallucinated the hosts of the 2012 KBS Drama Awards (Yoon Doo-joon, Park Ji-yoon, Lee Hwi-jae instead of Yoo Jun-sang and Lee Jong-suk) and included these hallucinated entities in the query.
The agent used passage indices (`[1], [2]`) instead of document titles for the "Retrieved required evidence documents" list.
The agent used a descriptive string instead of document titles for the "Missing required evidence documents" list.
The agent formulated the query as a natural language question, which is generally suboptimal for keyword-based retrieval.
